profile.summary: potatopeelings is a mid-level JavaScript developer with demonstrated expertise in vanilla JavaScript and the Chart.js library. Their contributions focus on frontend development, specifically charting logic, DOM manipulation, and event-driven programming. They exhibit strong proficiency in ES6+ features and modular JavaScript design patterns, contributing to core chart implementations (e.g., horizontal, stacked, and grouped bar charts). While their contributions are frontend-focused and do not involve frameworks like React or Vue, they demonstrate clean code practices, documentation updates, and adherence to modern JavaScript standards. Their work suggests familiarity with event-driven architectures and functional programming elements within the context of data visualization.
